actionOutputSchema.description: You are placing planning orders for this round. Assign an order preference to each required occupied area, respecting the displayed restrictions and starred-order limit. Your final answer submits the whole order draft and marks your house ready. These orders determine what your armies can do later; this decision does not move units. The harness allocates the physical order tokens, preserving higher-priority preferences when not all requested categories fit the available tokens.
